sources.title: Yangshuo Impression Sanjie Liu: Tickets, Transport & Tips
sources.content:
Yangshuo Impression Sanjie Liu: Complete Overview

Introduction & Show Details
Impression Sanjie Liu is a spectacular night performance in Yangshuo, choreographed by Zhang Yimou, the renowned director of the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games Opening Ceremony. The show uses "the Li River and surrounding karst mountains as the stage and backdrop," lasting approximately one hour. It combines music, lighting, ethnic songs, and dances in an open-air venue.

Performance Schedule
Regular showing times:
- Weekdays (Monday-Friday): 8:00 PM
- Weekends and holidays: 7:30 PM and 9:05 PM
Note: The show may close January and February. Performance times can change due to seasonal, weather, and other factors.

Best Seasons to Visit
Autumn (September-November) offers "less rainfall and cooler evenings" for optimal viewing. Spring may bring occasional rain; disposable ponchos are provided for light rain. Heavy rain or storms result in cancellation and full refund. Summer performances face crowds and mosquitoes. Winter (December-February) requires warm clothing and is generally not recommended.

Seven Performance Scenes
The production features seven distinct scenes: The Prelude, Red Impression, Green Impression, Golden Impression, Blue Impression, Silver Impression, and The Epilogue. The Silver Impression showcases "200 ethnic minority girls in festive costumes" performing on a water stage.

Seating Options
"B1-class could be the most cost-effective choice." A Zone seats offer rain protection. B2 and C zones provide accessible front seating via barrier-free passages, though higher seats require walking. Arrive an hour early to avoid crowds.

Location & Transportation
Address: No. 1 Tianyuan Road, Yangshuo County, Guilin (Lijiang Landscape Theater)
Getting there:
- Walking: approximately 25 minutes from West Street
- Electric scooters: about 10 minutes from West Street
- Hotel shuttle: available from select hotels (book in advance)

Ticketing Information
Reserve seats online up to one month ahead. "We suggest booking at least three days in advance to ensure your seat." Online purchase is recommended over offline options due to queuing and language barriers.

Visitor Suitability
The performance uses "Mandarin Chinese and local dialect" with "no Chinese or English subtitles." While visually impressive, understanding dialogue requires artistic appreciation. The show may not suit young children due to its length and language barrier.

The Legend of Sanjie Liu
Sanjie Liu was a legendary Zhuang girl renowned for exceptional singing ability, earning her the title "Song Fairy." According to tradition, she lived centuries ago (Tang Dynasty: 618-907) in Guangxi Province. Her story involves a love match with A Niu, who won her affection by singing beneath a Big Banyan Tree in Yangshuo County. An embroidered ball she gave him symbolized her acceptance.

Practical Tips
- Bring insect repellent for nighttime bugs
- Rain capes work better than umbrellas (which are prohibited)
- Summer shows are noisier with more children; later performances are quieter
- A-zone seating recommended during rainy season (May-August)
- Arrive one hour early to secure good viewing spots

sources.content:
Impression Sanjie Liu: Complete Article Text

Show Overview
"Impression Sanjie Liu is an amazing outdoor performance directed by Zhang Yimou." The production utilizes natural landscapes as its stage, incorporating "12 mountain peaks and a 2-kilometer water area of the Li River as a backdrop." Over 600 performers wearing traditional ethnic clothing participate in this spectacular performance.

Performance Structure
The show comprises seven distinct segments:
1. Prelude - Mountain and Water Legend - Sets the scenic backdrop
2. Red Impression - Sing Again - Features traditional folk songs with passionate red staging
3. Green Impression - Home - Showcases local people's connection to nature
4. Blue Impression - Love Song - Presents romantic musical performances
5. Golden Impression - Fishing Fire - Displays traditional fishing techniques
6. Silver Impression - Festival - Celebrates cultural traditions through dance and music
7. Finale - Praise of Heaven and Earth - Honors nature's beauty

Key Practical Information
Location: Li River Landscape Theater, Guanlian Road, Yangshuo County, China
Show Times: Performances occur twice nightly at 19:45 and 21:20, lasting approximately one hour each

Ticketing: Adult tickets available; children 1.2-1.39 meters pay 118 yuan; children over 1.4 meters purchase adult tickets. "Folding chairs are available at the theater entrance" for children without reserved seating.

Transportation Options:
- Walking: 1.8 kilometers from West Street (approximately 30 minutes)
- Dedicated car transfers: 20 yuan per person, departing around 18:30 or 19:30
- Battery car/van service from West Street entrance
- Online taxi services

Visitor Tips
Arrive at least 30 minutes early for optimal seating and pre-show activities. "The higher the seat, the better the view of the performance." First show attendance is recommended for better viewing experiences.

Pre-Show Activities
Explore the Liu Sanjie Museum, browse local food stalls, and view calligraphy and painting auctions before performances begin.

Nearby Attractions
Yangshuo offers additional exploration opportunities including Li River boat cruises, West Street shopping, Yulong River bamboo rafting, Moon Hill hiking, Reed Flute Cave, and Yangshuo Park.

sources.title: The Impression Liu Sanjie Show: Facts and Tips
sources.content:
The Impression Liu Sanjie Show: Facts and Tips

"Performing on the stunning Li River in Yangshuo, Impression Liu Sanjie is a large natural show that's performed at night." Directed by renowned filmmaker Zhang Yimou, this performance merges artistic expression with environmental conservation.

Performers: The show features 600 local residents rather than professional actors. These include farmers, fishermen, and young women from Yangshuo who volunteer to showcase their hometown's cultural heritage.

Historical Inspiration: The performance draws from a local legend about Liu Sanjie, a legendary singer and beautiful woman. According to tradition, a warlord kidnapped her after she rejected his advances, but her farmer lover successfully rescued her.

Cultural Connection: A 1961 film titled "Liu Sanjie" introduced generations of Chinese to Guilin's landscapes and folk music. The current show builds upon this classic story.

The Stage: "The vast sky, the gentle Li River, and 12 mountains form the background for this performance." The natural setting adapts to weather conditions—performances vary based on rain, season, and time of year.

Technical Elements: The production utilizes advanced environmental lighting and special smoke effects to create a dreamlike atmosphere.

Practical Travel Information
Location: Li River, Yangshuo County, Guilin, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region
Duration: 1-2 hours

Show Times:
- First: 8pm-9:10pm
- Second: 9:40pm-10:50pm

Ticket Prices:
- Standard B2: 268 yuan ($42)
- Standard B1: 368 yuan ($58)
- VIP A2: 628 yuan ($98)
- VIP A1: 828 yuan ($129)

Transportation: Battery electric cars available; 5-10 minutes, costs 15 yuan ($3)

sources.title: All you need to know about: Impressions – Liu San Jie
sources.content:
Impressions Liu San Jie: Complete Article Text

What is it?
"Impressions Liu San Jie is a music, dance and light show with of over 600 performers, set on the largest natural theatre in the world." The Li River south of Yangshuo serves as the stage, with 12 Karst mountain peaks forming the backdrop. An audience of 5,000 sits in a stadium on an island in the river for this nighttime performance directed by filmmaker Zhang Yimou, who also helmed the 2008 Olympic Games opening ceremony.

The show is rooted in Zhuang people legend. The Zhuang comprise one of China's 56 ethnic groups with 15 million members, second only to Han Chinese. Liu Sanjie, meaning "third sister in the Liu family," possessed a beautiful voice that captivated all who heard it. According to legend, a warlord fell in love with her, but she had already devoted herself to a farmer boy. After the warlord kidnapped her, her lover and villagers rescued her, and the couple escaped to happiness.

Rather than traditional plot and dialogue, the performance uses "impressions" representing landscapes and daily life where Liu Sanjie was born. Segments include "red impression – folk songs, green impression – gardens, gold impression – fishing and so on."

Tips for Attending

1. Just Go - If spending a night in Yangshuo, this show is essential. The performance closes during the month before Chinese New Year (late January/early February).

2. Book Early - Two shows nightly (three during peak season) fill completely. Weekend bookings require advance planning. Hotels arrange tickets and transportation.

3. Ticket Types:
- C tickets (198 RMB): Front seating, limited experience
- A1 tickets (680 RMB): Central "President suites," best viewing
- A2 tickets (480 RMB): Sided positioning
- B2 tickets (230 RMB): Good views, no roof protection from rain
- B1 tickets (320 RMB): Rear positioning, more expensive than B2
The author recommends B2 row 37 for dry seating under the A section roof while paying less and gaining better overall views.

4. Arrive Early - Allow 30+ minutes before start time for security checks and seating.

5. Stay Through Curtain Call - Many leave early, but the finale and potential cast photos reward patience.

6. Silent Phones - Treat this as traditional theater; silence devices completely.

7. Weather Preparation - Check forecasts; bring rain protection. Free ponchos sometimes provided. Bring towels for wet seats.

8. Facilities - Abundant restrooms well-signposted throughout; security screening at entrance; driver waiting areas available; minimal food vendors present.

The author rates this among the world's greatest live performances, comparing it favorably to Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

sources.title: Your Easy Guide to Impression Sanjie Liu Show Tickets (2026)
sources.content:
Impression Sanjie Liu Show Tickets Buying Guide (2026)

There are five different seating zones: C, B2, B1, A2, and A1. Ticket prices range from 198 to 680 CNY, varying according to different seating zones.

Children under 1.2 meters can enjoy free visit if sharing seat with adults. Children between 1.2 to 1.4 meters are required to purchase children rate.

The performance venue is an open-air space and requires a half-hour walk from West Street (approximately 10 minutes by electric scooter).

You can buy tickets easily in town from hotels, guides and agencies, or book online through platforms like Viator.

The best season to attend the show is autumn (September-November), when there is less rainfall and cooler evenings. The show is usually closed from the lunar December to the next lunar January 2nd every year due to the cold water and too low temperature.

Arriving at least half an hour early is a good idea as there are a lot of things to see and do before the show starts. Bring a fan if you are visiting from May to August, since the weather is likely to be hot and humid, and also remember to apply insect repellent to keep the mosquitoes away.

sources.title: 印象·刘三姐_百度百科
sources.content:
印象·刘三姐 - 百度百科

基本信息
《印象·刘三姐》是2004年由桂林广维文华旅游文化产业有限公司投资制作的大型山水实景演出。张艺谋、王潮歌、樊跃担任总导演，梅帅元任总策划。

演出特色
该演出以广西壮族民间传说"刘三姐"为原型，"融合漓江水域自然景观与壮、瑶、苗、侗等少数民族文化元素"。舞台覆盖约1.654平方公里水域及12座山峰，演员包括600余名当地居民及专业演员。

发展历程
- 2004年3月20日：在阳朔县漓江山水剧场首演
- 2017年：运营公司因负债超15亿元申请破产重整
- 2024年3月：累计演出超8000场，接待观众2000万人次
- 2026年2月：已演出9000多场，接待观众超2200万人次

艺术成就
作为"中国第一部大型山水实景演出"，该项目运用"国画构图手法展现渔民劳作、民俗风情等场景"。世界旅游组织推荐称其为全球独特的演出体验。

社会影响
该项目曾带动阳朔当地GDP增长5%，创造就业机会并形成文化旅游产业链。至2025年，累计演出92,142场次，观众高达3120万人次，票房收入高达60亿元。

sources.title: 阳朔《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出游玩攻略 - 携程攻略
sources.content:
印象刘三姐游玩攻略（携程）

演出地点：阳朔县田园路1号，中国漓江山水剧场

演出时间：首场19:40、第二场21:10、第三场22:00之后，每场表演约为70分钟。

门票价格：
- 普通票198元/张
- 贵宾席位B2为238元/张，B1为320元/张
- 总统席位A2为480元/张，A1为680元/张
- 1.2米以下儿童不收门票费用
- 1.2-1.4米儿童需购儿童票（85元/人）
- 超过1.4米按成人票收取

购票建议：订票请到携程、去哪儿等平台或印象刘三姐门票官网预定，法定节假日期间的门票需提前7天预订。

注意事项：
- 不允许未经允许使用无人机
- 建议携带防蚊产品
- 提前查看天气预报，下雨请带雨具
- 演出为中文和方言，无中英文字幕
- 建议提前到达，乘坐阳朔809路公交至气象局站步行可达
- 租用小电驴出行最为推荐

sources.title: 印象刘三姐买票注意事项，曝光阳朔印象刘三姐门票价格的猫腻
sources.content:
印象刘三姐买票注意事项

《印象·刘三姐》是由著名导演张艺谋、王潮歌、樊跃任总导演的大型山水实景演出，是全国第一部全新概念的"山水实景演出"。演出依托自然万物的支撑，把两公里的漓江水域、十二座山峰和广袤天穹都化为了演出舞台的组成部分。

演出分为五个座位区域：C区、B2区、B1区、A2区、A1区。其中B2区好看还是B1区好看：如果追求性价比推荐B2区；如果追求最佳观看体验推荐A1区中间位置。

提示：法定节假日期间的门票需提前7天预订。非节假日期间提前1-2天预订即可。建议通过正规渠道购票避免被宰。
